research_goal: Independent registry-first macroecological analysis of original animal movement directions relative to the astronomical solar bearing, not synthesis of published effects or model-prediction competition.

frame.first_pass: Retain every package and report GPS/GNSS candidates separately from Argos. Sensor metadata does not establish temporal or positional precision. Enforce original archive checksum before biological analysis.
frame.pilot_status: post_previous_source_exposure_exploratory; no selection based on newly observed solar azimuth outcomes
frame.source_independence: Study IDs, DOI package versions, deployments, individuals and shared research populations require deduplication before meta-regression. Package count is not study count.

hypotheses: H1: Original GPS step direction has nonzero solar-relative covariance across suitably sampled individuals, but neither raw alignment nor covariance alone is a biological response to sunlight.

H2: The distribution of within-individual solar-relative association differs among independently sampled populations, biomes, body-size/movement guilds and thermal/vegetation contexts, after nuisance clock, direction and sampling structure are considered.
H3: At comparable solar geometry, ecological season and local microclimate can modify directionality; global direction of change is not presumed universal.

observation.timestamps: Original UTC; timezone and interval provenance must be verified source by source.
observation.heading: Initial great-circle bearing of GPS displacement, north-clockwise, not body-facing direction.
observation.solar_position: NOAA fractional-year geometric sun azimuth/elevation at source step midpoint and its actual geographical position, not synthetic civil time shift.
observation.solar_position_accuracy: Approximate NOAA equation; accurate ephemeris sensitivity and reported GPS positional accuracy required for confirmatory extension.

outcomes.raw_toward_sun: Mean cos(bearing - solar_azimuth), only a compass-space description.
outcomes.raw_solar_axis: Mean cos(2*(bearing - solar_azimuth)), tests axis without sunward/antisunward sign.
outcomes.compass_marginal_excess: Mean cos relative bearing minus the exact product-of-compass-marginal and sun-marginal term, per animal year.
outcomes.primary_identifiability_diagnostic: Clock-adjusted within-individual-year month × 2-hour apparent-solar-time-bin circular covariance; cells require >=8 GPS steps, >=3 distinct solar dates and >=5-degree circular solar azimuth span. No suitable cells => UNIDENTIFIABLE, not a biological null.
outcomes.minimum_individual_year: At least 30 eligible steps across five solar dates
outcomes.aggregate: Equal eligible solar-time strata within animal-year, equal years within animal, equal animals within source-taxon. Never weight source groups by GPS fixes.
outcomes.bootstrap: 1000 individual-cluster draws, descriptive 95% percentiles conditional on a fixed source population; no source-independent confidence or universal response test.
outcomes.data_policy: No exact locations, animal IDs, timestamps or full tracks in committed files, CI logs or artifacts.

macro_next_stage.independent_units: Study-population blocks, not 437 packages, repeated GPS fixes or many animals within the same shared environment.
macro_next_stage.model: Multilevel circular-covariance meta-regression by source population, species and independent region; diagnose study-sensor and taxonomic heterogeneity, spatial autocorrelation and coverage bias.
macro_next_stage.identification: Solar bearing and apparent solar time are geometrically linked at a fixed site and date. Clock-conditioned contrast identifies only residual variation with adequate support; no statistical method alone proves directional orientation to solar cues.
macro_next_stage.primary_validation: Preselect environmentally contrasted independent source populations and hold out whole original study/region identities; do not promote initial cherry-picked pilot to confirmation.

current_status: Protocol and new software branch; original-azimuth outcome unavailable until source-verified workflow executes.
